groups.sentence: Instructors and departments increase human interactions in their courses.
Instructors keep feedback and faculty-student engagement human-centered and personal rather than AI-generated.
Students do not use AI tutoring to replace human interaction with instructors or teaching assistants.
Overreliance on AI can reduce human interaction, support, and feedback between students and instructors or peers.
AI is a supplementary tool, not a replacement for human interaction, relationships, or instructors' guidance.
Instructors use AI to augment teaching, not replace the presence, expertise, and care of the instructor.
Teaching assistants and staff do not let AI replace the human element needed for reflective conversations, though it may handle mundane questions.
